Ben

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Installation Problem
parts:
On Wednesday, July 31, 2013 1:26:38 PM UTC-4, Jared Harpole wrote:
Compilation argument: C:/PROGRA~1/R/bin/x64/R CMD SHLIB filefa05e9242e0.cpp 2> filefa05e9242e0.cpp.err.txt g++ -m64 -I"C:/PROGRA~1/R/include" -DDEBUG -I"C:/Users/Owner/R/win-library/3.0/Rcpp/include" -I"d:/RCompile/CRANpkg/extralibs64/local/include" -O0 -Wall -mtune=core2 -g -c filefa05e9242e0.cpp -o filefa05e9242e0.o

Yes, the -g flag is what needs to be eliminated. Maybe you have a Makevars file in $HOME/.R/ ?

Also, you should change -O0 to -O3. I think -mtune=core2 and -m64 are okay.

Ben
